settings.heading: Why Pococo Feels Different at Night
settings.body: Designed to help you create a calmer room, reduce screen time, and ease into rest.

settings.title: No App. No Phone. No Bedtime Scrolling.
settings.body: Control everything with three simple buttons — power, rotate, and timer. No Wi‑Fi, no setup, no notifications.
settings.alt: Pococo projector close-up showing three physical buttons

settings.title: Create a Softer Way to Unwind
settings.body: Fill your ceiling and walls with slow-moving celestial scenes that help your room feel quieter and more peaceful.
settings.alt: Person relaxing in a bedroom while celestial scenes are projected on the wall

settings.title: Realistic Stars, Not Laser Dots
settings.body: Pococo uses projection discs with detailed cosmic scenes, giving your room a more immersive night-sky experience.
settings.alt: Detailed moon phases projected across a bedroom wall

settings.title: Soft Light That Won’t Take Over the Room
settings.body: Gentle, indirect projection creates ambiance without harsh brightness, making it easier to relax before sleep.
settings.alt: Children inside a fort lit softly by Pococo projection
